payload.title: The in-flight branch converter folds the registry with its own foldedById, a second fold beside foldRegistry: it applies logs to genesis rows only and skips every event-born log
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept: the registry fold is foldRegistry in finding-registry-projection.ts
payload.notes: No wrong output today: a pre-freeze branch edits genesis rows only, which the copy folds. The copy is a second spelling of the fold that a change to the projection's rules (a new event type, a derived field) does not reach, so the converter's 'current' row can come apart from the row readers see. Read from the code, not probed. Close condition: foldedById is deleted and the converter takes its current rows from foldRegistry (through the events.ts map), or the whole converter is deleted first by PROC-MEDIUM-062. A grep of the converter for applyFindingEvent finds no fold of its own.
